core_idea: The Index Proselyte:【Paper Slip】 Faust is a Damage Dealer / Status Specialist — **Poise** fighter — stack on self, then spend on crits and scaling. Poise is a self-buff: on hit it rolls a Potency-based crit for 1.2x damage.
playstyle_guide:
- Build **Poise Count** and **Potency** for crits and Coin Power scaling before committing **As the Prescript Demands, You Will Be Eliminated.** — **S2 — Undertake the Prescript, Again Undertake** adds **+3 Poise** at **On Use** and **+1 Poise** per **On Hit** coin; **S1 — Unerringly, as the Prescript Demands** adds **+2 Poise Count** at **On Use** and **+1 Poise** per **On Hit** coin.
- **As the Prescript Demands, You Will Be Eliminated.** is your highest-damage skill — use the setup skills above first, then commit it once stacks are up.

**S1 — Unerringly, as the Prescript Demands** (BP 3, CP +4, 2 coins): rolls — low 3, high 11 (Slightly Low / Slightly High stacked).
- If this Skill is marked with Mark of the Prescript, Clash Power +1 and deal +20% damage ; Coin Power +1 for every 6 (Poise on self + Sinking on target) (max 2) ; [On Use] Gain +2 Poise Count

**S2 — Undertake the Prescript, Again Undertake** (BP 4, CP +4, 3 coins): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Average).
- If this Skill is marked with Mark of the Prescript, Final Power +1 ; Coin Power +1 for every 6 (Poise on self + Sinking on target) (max 2) ; [On Use] Gain 3 Poise and +2 Poise Count

**S3 — As the Prescript Demands, You Will Be Eliminated.** (BP 5, CP +4, 3 coins, +30% on crit): rolls — low 5, high 17 (Average / Slightly High stacked).
- Deal +2.5% damage for every Grace of the Prescript (max 20%); - At 9 Grace of the Prescript, deal +30% damage instead; [On Hit] Inflict 1 Sinking; [On Crit] Inflict +2 Sinking Count

  - At 9 Grace of the Prescript, deal +20% damage with Base Skills instead.
  - On Hit with a Base Skill against target that has The Prescript's Target, gain 1 Poise and inflict 1 Sinking (once per turn).

Defense skill — **Counter: Prescript-granted, Prescript-woven Fabric**: Final Power +1 and deal +10% damage for every 3 Grace of the Prescript (max 3 and 30%, respectively).
  - [Combat Start] Gain Shield equal to 15% of max HP (once per turn).
  - Reduce Shield gained by 1.5% for every 5 Karmic Consequence.
  - [On Use] Gain 2 Poise.
